meta.id_map_note: retired blob id -> blob that now contains its largest member (verdicts given under the old id apply there)
meta.grouping_note: neighbours (touching or <= gap_km apart) merge when nested/overlapping or when the EOX colour step across their shared border is small (dE < 3.5, stark < 0.15; tools/review/pair_contrast.py); blocks > 1500 km across are tiled into 6-degree cells
meta.umbrella_note: umb=1: every member has a paper/umbrella designation (biosphere, transfrontier, Ramsar, hunting area, APA...); hidden by default, sorted last
meta.rank_note: sort key: area-weighted mean member score over members that are mostly land (measured share >= 0.4)
meta.score_note: best edge-contrast score among members (max of EOX measure.py score and Google gmeasure.py score); calibration: visible reserves ~6-60, invisible rainforest/desert reserves < 2. null = not measured yet.
